mapper.select: SELECT id, member_name, check_date, work_in_time, vacation_yn, CASE /* 오늘 날짜이고, 퇴근 시간이 없거나(공백 포함) 현재 시각보다 미래인 경우 '-' 처리 */ WHEN check_date = CURRENT_DATE AND ( work_out_time IS NULL OR TRIM(work_out_time) = '' OR (check_date + work_out_time::TIME) > LOCALTIMESTAMP ) THEN '-' /* 그 외(과거 날짜이거나 정상 완료된 퇴근 시간)는 그대로 표시 */ ELSE work_out_time END AS work_out_time FROM attendance WHERE check_date BETWEEN #{startDate}::DATE AND #{endDate}::DATE AND check_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY check_date ASC, member_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( member_name, check_date, work_in_time, work_out_time, vacation_yn ) VALUES ( #{memberName}, #{checkDate}::DATE, #{workInTime}, #{workOutTime}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{vacationYn}, ''), 'N') )
